title: Semrush Domain Overview Scraper
description: Semrush Domain Overview Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /semrush/domain/overview endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Batch input entries. Each domain is sent as the domain value.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Root domain or subdomain to analyze

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum dataset items to save across this entire run.
